list.snippet: Mega Charizard X ex (Special Illustration Rare #125): The chase card of the set featuring artwork by takuyoa, raw/ungraded copies generally trade between $535 and $999, while top-tier PSA 10 graded versions command over $1,500.
Mega Charizard X ex (Ultra Rare #109): A more accessible version of the card, with raw copies and lower-grade slabs typically ranging from $38 to $69.
Gold Mega Charizard X ex: An ultra-rare Mega Ultra Rare (MUR) gold card variant with market values spanning $600 to $650.

Release & Pricing: Booster boxes for Phantasmal Flames launched around late 2025 and have held a strong aftermarket price of roughly $300, while Ultra Premium Collection (UPC) boxes trade closer to $200.

Community Reception: Opinions on PokéBeach are mixed; some collectors feel the extremely low pull rates for the Special Illustration Rare make completing the set too expensive and frustrating, while others believe high scarcity helps preserve long-term hobby value.
